title: Noctune Changelog Snippet
description: A changelog entry snippet written to pending_changes/ by the runner after commit. Parsed by the release job to build CHANGELOG.md.

type.description: Conventional commit type — release job parses this for CHANGELOG grouping

area.description: Top-level src/ directory name, or agent/pipeline/meta

summary.description: One-line imperative summary of the change

details.description: Multi-line details for the CHANGELOG entry

task.description: Queue entry id that produced this changelog snippet
